scan_scope: all parseable JSON files in repository worktree, filename plus content

known_corpus_gaps.scarab_khepri: No dedicated reverse-decoder Scarab/Khepri corpus exists yet; current matches are sparse and mostly incidental.
known_corpus_gaps.psychostasia_maat: No dedicated Psychostasia JSON was found; Maat appears only sparsely. Build a source-bound heart/feather judgement corpus before calibration.
known_corpus_gaps.egyptian_revival_negative_control: No dedicated Egyptian Revival negative-control artifact was identified by this scan. Build one before unknown-symbol promotion.
known_corpus_gaps.blindness: Wedjat, Khepri and Maat semantics have already appeared in the project discussion; current operator cannot count them as pristine blind tests without a new annotator/agent or fresh held-out symbols.

interpretation_rule: Inventory membership means potentially relevant retrieval surface, not evidentiary endorsement. Keyword/entity hits are not independent evidence and may include project hypotheses, controls, fiction mirrors, or superseded versions.
